wrong.name: usage line as the missing-task detail
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'run needs --task FILE|- (a task file, or - for standard input)'

wrong.name: extra argument is not named
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'run takes no argument besides --task, got "extra"'

wrong.name: flag error reported as the missing task
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'flag provided but not defined: -bogus'

wrong.name: only zero-length input is empty
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'the task read from standard input is empty'

wrong.name: file empty uses the standard-input wording
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'the task file empty-task.json is empty'

wrong.name: non-JSON input called empty
wrong.step: Then kogen-loop-run-refusals-name-the-fault: the run refusal has detail 'invalid task: expected one JSON object'
